description.message: Fills logins and passwords from the WhoKey password manager

waiting.message:
Opening WhoKey — enter your master password.
I will fill in as soon as it opens.

no_entries.message:
No entries for $1.
In WhoKey, open the entry and set its “Website”.

filled_login.message: Login filled ✓ The password comes on the next step — press again.

no_field.message: No login or password field found on this page.

moved.message: The page changed — open the login form and press again.

denied.message: WhoKey did not allow the extension.

locked.message: WhoKey was not unlocked. Enter your master password in WhoKey and press again.

not_installed.message: WhoKey not found. Install it and run it once — it will set up the browser.

bridge_closed.message: The connection to WhoKey was lost. Try again.

bad_page.message: Filling only works on secure websites (https).

not_found.message: Entry not found — it may have just changed. Open the popup again.

hint.message: $KEY$ opens this popup from the keyboard

pairing.message:
WhoKey asks to confirm the connection.
Code: $1 — allow it if WhoKey shows the same code.

busy.message: Too many requests in a row. Wait a minute.

timeout.message: WhoKey did not answer in time. Try again.

fake_app.message: Another program answered instead of WhoKey — nothing was sent. Restart WhoKey.

ambiguous.message: There are several password fields on the page — press $KEY$ again and choose the account.
